theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and S a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let pi:C->S be a smooth proper family of geometrically connected genus-six curves, and let gamma:C->P^1_S be finite flat of degree four with the standard degree-four Casnati-Ekedahl resolution and fibrewise balanced relations bundle F_s≅O(4)⊕O(5). Assume the weak CE normalization O_X(1)|_{C_s}≅omega_{C_s/P^1}⊗gamma_s^*A_s on every geometric fibre. Let W_5 be the degree-sixteen quotient in the canonical filtered CE equation bundle, using W_f=(O_X(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C, and put L=W_5⊗omega_{C/S}^{-1}. Let AJ=Hilb^6(C/S)×_{Pic^6(C/S)}S be the Abel-Jacobi incidence over [L], let U⊂AJ be its distinct-support open, let B=Conf_6(C/S), and let Z⊂B be the intrinsic CE evaluation-failure scheme defined by Fit_0(coker(pi_*W->pi_*(W|_Gamma))) for the universal ordered divisor Gamma. Then: (1) no geometric fibre is hyperelliptic, L_s≅omega_{C_s}(-gamma_s^*O(1)), h^0(L_s)=3 and h^1(L_s)=2; in particular the h^0=4 stratum is empty. (2) AJ is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over S. The open U is fibrewise nonempty and dense, is S-smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two, and its complement in every geometric P^2-fibre is closed of dimension exactly one; consequently U is not closed fibrewise. (3) Scheme-theoretically, Z is the finite etale right S_6-torsor Ord(U)->U of orderings of the universal reduced divisor, of degree 720. The right S_6-action has trivial geometric-point stabilizers, Z->S is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two, and Z->B is a regular closed immersion of pure codimension four. If S is of finite type, every irreducible component of Z dominates an irreducible component S_alpha of S and has dimension dim(S_alpha)+2. (4) More precisely, for any connected normal component U_alpha of U, choose a geometric point and an ordering, and let H_alpha⊂S_6 be the resulting monodromy image. The irreducible components of Z×_U U_alpha are indexed by the orbit set H_alpha\S_6, represented by right cosets H_alpha g; their number is [S_6:H_alpha], and the stabilizer of the component H_alpha g under the right deck action is g^{-1}H_alpha g. This formula does not compute H_alpha. No assertion is made about irreducible components, dimensions, or inertia in M_{6,6}, about a representable forgetful morphism to M_{6,6}, or about Tate type.
